NAI Trading · anonymized-window simulation

OpenAI comparison · first 60 SOL setups

SOL-USD · 60 windows · 15-minute bars, 40 visible · price rebased to 100, no dates · resolved by first passage on 1-minute history · AI: gpt-5.6-luna-agent, gpt-5.6-terra-agent, gpt-6-astra-agent

180 accepted decisions · 60 identical saved SOL setups · 3 OpenAI models.
This update adds setups 11–60 (150 decisions) to the preserved first 10 (30 decisions).

Method, isolation audit and source records

Each decision used a fresh subagent, no inherited conversation, medium reasoning, the original saved numeric prompt and chart, and the same trade contract. Input files contain the contract followed by the original market prompt. Every accepted new agent passed an audit of its tool calls and complete text/image delivery. No previous decisions or outcomes were supplied.

Isolation is instruction-based and audited, not an OS/tool sandbox. 0 new attempts were excluded before scoring and retained separately. The first-10 run retains its original eight excluded attempts and documented wrapper changes. Codex and Claude Code harnesses differ, so this is not a model-weights-only comparison.

Existing evaluator: one-minute first passage, 72-hour time stop, 20bps round-trip costs. The original prompt does not specify the timeout. Excursions include the full exit bar. Per-trade averages are not portfolio returns; these historical masked results are exploratory.
